integrity: The theorem is proved directly. The eventual-image corollary uses the general finite-space retract criterion of Barmak. Computational checks are explicitly finite and auxiliary.
scientific_limitations: The proof exploits the total ordering of antichain levels in a finite weak order and is not asserted for arbitrary graded posets. Small exhaustive computations verify representative cases but do not replace the general proof. An older equivalent order-theoretic formulation under different terminology remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Singleton-gap criterion for retracts and eventual images of finite weak orders
